link.title: Using AI With Bitbybit
link.description: Use AI assistants to help write Bitbybit scripts. Large language models are reasonable at generating geometry code once they know the API, and Bitbybit publishes context files and an MCP integration specifically so they can. These pages cover the prompt context files that give an assistant the API surface, using the Model Context Protocol so a tool like Claude or Cursor can look up documentation as it works, and what AI-assisted 3D development is realistically good at today. Practical rather than speculative: what actually helps, and where you still need to check the output.
